ruleContent.content: @js:var NL=String.fromCharCode(10);var b=String(baseUrl||'');var q=b.split('/');var cid=q[3]||'';var ch=(q[4]||'').replace('.html','');var api='https://comic.mkzcdn.com/chapter/content/?comic_id='+cid+'&chapter_id='+ch;var h='';try{h=String(java.ajax(api));}catch(e){h='';}var o={};try{o=JSON.parse(h);}catch(e){o={};}var d=o.data||[];var out=[];var HD=',{"headers":{"Referer":"https://www.mkzhan.com/"}}';for(var i=0;i<d.length;i++){var im=d[i]&&d[i].image;if(im){out.push(String(im).replace('http:','https:')+HD);}}result=out.join(NL);
